licence.renewsTogether.value: The establishment card expiry is not linked to the trade licence expiry; they renew separately, and the card can be renewed within 2 months before its own expiry. Renewed documents (trade licence, establishment card, COC certificate) appear in the service request, and E-channel must be updated to renew the establishment card. Lease renewal together with the licence: unknown.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Ajman Free Zone (AFZ), renews together (official AFZ FAQ, CONFIRMED); https://afz.gov.ae/en/help-and-support/faqs.html

licence.afterExpiry.value: A grace period of one month after licence expiry, within which renewal is possible. What happens after that is unknown from an official source.
